title: A Spice Tour on Zanzibar: What You See and Taste
excerpt: Zanzibar is known as the Spice Island. On a spice tour you see, smell and taste cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon and more.
body:
Zanzibar's history is closely linked to spices, especially cloves. A spice tour is one of the most popular excursions on the island.

## What happens

A guide takes you around a spice farm, usually in the countryside near Stone Town. You see how plants grow and are harvested, and you get to smell and taste:

- Cloves
- Nutmeg and mace
- Cinnamon
- Black pepper
- Vanilla
- Cardamom
- Lemongrass
- Turmeric and ginger

Fruits like jackfruit, starfruit and rambutan often feature too.

## Extras

Many tours include a lunch with spiced dishes, palm-leaf crafts made on the spot and someone climbing a coconut palm.

## History

Cloves were introduced to Zanzibar in the early 19th century and became a major export, cultivated with enslaved labour. A good guide covers that history honestly.

## Practical

Half-day trip. Wear comfortable shoes and bring mosquito repellent.

## Combine

With a [cooking class](/blog/zanzibar-cooking-class/) or [Jozani Forest](/blog/jozani-forest-red-colobus/).

[Add a spice tour](/travel-proposal/).
